jobs.title: Expert Talend / PL/SQL – Reporting prudentiel bancaire
jobs.description:
Notre client recherche un Expert Talend / PL/SQL – Reporting prudentiel bancaire (H/F) dans le cadre d’une mission freelance.

Au sein d'une DSI bancaire, la mission intervient dans le domaine Risques, Finance et Conformité, sur les systèmes de production des reportings prudentiels destinés aux autorités de supervision bancaire (BCE et ACPR).

Les enjeux portent notamment sur les évolutions réglementaires CRR3, la sécurisation des productions prudentielles et les projets de transformation du SI.

Étudier et concevoir les évolutions des solutions de traitement et d'intégration des données.
Développer et maintenir les flux ETL Talend, les modèles de données Oracle et les scripts PL/SQL.
Réaliser les développements nécessaires à la production des reportings prudentiels et internes.
Participer aux évolutions techniques liées à CRR3 et à la sécurisation des traitements.
Réaliser les tests unitaires et d'intégration.
Accompagner les phases de recette et de mise en production.
Assurer le support technique des productions prudentielles, notamment lors des arrêtés mensuels.
Collaborer avec la maîtrise d'ouvrage et produire la documentation technique et projet.

Livrables

Études de cadrage et dossiers de conception générale.
Chiffrages détaillés et propositions de planning.
Spécifications techniques détaillées.
Modèles conceptuels et physiques de données.
Jobs Talend, modèles de bases de données SQL et scripts PL/SQL.
Documentation projet et procédures internes.
Recettes unitaires et d'intégration.
Support à la recette, à la mise en production et aux utilisateurs en production.

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Contract

Industries

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

At CluePoints, we’re redefining how clinical trials are run. As the premier provider of Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) and Data Quality Oversight software, we harness advanced statistics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning to ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of clinical trial data, helping life sciences organisations bring safer, more effective treatments to patients faster.

We’re an ambitious, fast-growing technology scale-up with a dynamic and diverse international team. Collaboration, flexibility, and continuous learning are part of our DNA, and we are guided by our values of Care, Passion, and Smart Disruption.

The Role

The Data Engineer will build the pipelines, connectors and harmonized data snapshots at the heart of CluePoints’ new data layer. The layer brings together data from different studies and applications so that CluePoints’ consumer applications can use it, with auditability and regulatory compliance designed in from the start.

You will work with the platform architect and the AI Engineer to turn the architecture into reliable, production-grade data flows. Success looks like trustworthy, traceable, harmonized snapshots, delivered consistently across studies and data sources.

Job Requirements

Strong practical experience designing and running production-grade ingestion, transformation and orchestration pipelines.
Advanced SQL and strong Python development skills.
Hands-on experience with Databricks and/or Snowflake and modern lakehouse or warehouse architectures.
Experience integrating data from databases, APIs and SaaS applications.
Strong data modelling skills, including layered data architectures.
Experience with Git-based development, code review, automated testing and CI/CD.
Experience implementing data-quality controls, observability, monitoring and alerting.
Understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage and traceability, and why they matter in regulated settings.
Ability to reconcile data with differing structures and variables and to validate it against source systems.
High autonomy and ownership from requirements through deployment, monitoring and maintenance.

Nice To Have

Experience in clinical trials, life sciences or another regulated environment, or familiarity with clinical data standards (for example CDISC) and data-capture system exports.
Experience designing metadata-driven pipelines or harmonizing data across heterogeneous sources.
Experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog and Databricks Asset Bundles, and with Microsoft Azure.
Experience building integrations into customer-managed data environments.
Practical use of generative AI in data engineering workflows, and awareness of knowledge graphs and RAG.

Job Responsibilities

Data-Layer Pipelines & Harmonization

Build and maintain production pipelines that bring data from different studies and applications into the data layer.
Implement harmonization logic that reconciles studies with differing variables, including approaches driven by metadata from data-capture solutions.
Produce harmonized data snapshots for CluePoints’ consumer applications, with clear refresh and versioning approaches.
Validate new or changed data flows against source systems and business expectations.

Connectors & Integration

Shape and build connector approaches for common data-capture systems.
Support customer-specific Databricks and Snowflake environments with secure, repeatable integration patterns.
Monitor and manage schema changes, missing data, duplication and inconsistencies between sources.
Evaluate new data sources and determine the most appropriate extraction and integration approach.

Auditability, Quality & Compliance

Ensure snapshots support auditability, traceability and regulatory compliance, including lineage, versioning and reproducibility.
Implement automated data-quality controls covering completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness and freshness.
Set up monitoring and alerting for pipeline failures, unexpected schema changes and data-quality issues.
Apply testing, validation and documentation standards appropriate to a regulated environment.

Platform Engineering & Collaboration

Contribute to technology evaluation and architecture decisions with the platform architect.
Establish version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD and orchestration practices for the data layer.
Monitor and optimize performance, resource usage and cost.
Work with the AI Engineer to make well-described, harmonized data available to retrieval and AI components.
Document critical solutions and share knowledge to avoid dependency on a single individual

Job Benefits

The chance to build a core data capability from the ground up: CluePoints has committed to the data layer, and the engineering patterns are still to be set.
A meaningful technical challenge: harmonizing data across studies with differing variables into auditable snapshots.
Input into technology choices, with room to evaluate options rather than inherit a fixed stack.
Close collaboration with a senior platform architect and an AI Engineer on a shared problem.
Direct visibility of how your pipelines and snapshots power CluePoints’ consumer applications.
Exposure to customer-specific Databricks and Snowflake environments across the life sciences industry.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Software Development
